reviews.title: Uneventful flight
reviews.text: First time flight with this airline. Sokhoi jet was surprisingly comfortable, plenty of leg room reclining seats made this long five hours trip comfortable. Free Small sandwiches and cold and hot drinks was great.

reviews.title: The worst airline company ever
reviews.text: I book my flights at end of December. Price of the billet 17 000 rubs. It has been canceled twice since the day of departure !! And before the flight, I booked was on 20 of January at 8:30 pm around, changed to 2:00 am the next day, then 8:40. So, the 21 of January, I come to the Airport, check-in, give my luggage, and after passing Passport control.... ANOTHER MESSAGE : Cancelled, now it is 12:05 and it is not even sure !! And to understand better, price of the ticket few days before of the flight I take now is 13 000 rubs. GREAT. Better to pay extra money, than take the worst airline company !!
reviews.author: Sébastien B

reviews.title: The worst!
reviews.text: This airline is stealing money from the passengers with made up rules regarding the COVID Vaccine and tests! Today we had a flight from Miami to Santo Domingo; the flight was at 8 am. We got there at 5 am; after 1.5 hrs in the line, the person at the counter asked us for the COVID Vaccine; they told us that because the vaccine is older than 270 days, we needed a PCR Test negative to travel; they told us right away that we won't be able to get in the plain because we needed to do the test. They charge us $100 per person as a penalization for "missing the flight" and then $175 per PCR test. This is so wrong!! We were not informed of these rules ahead; there is nothing on the ticket or reservation; their website doesn't say anything about a PCR to travel to the Dominican Republic. They are abusing the Venezuelan people's necessity to travel through their country.
reviews.author: Laura O

reviews.title: Worst ever !
reviews.text: Flight from Moscow Zhukovsky to Antalya on August 5th. I would say from beginning, the service on ground and on board is ascetic but it is more or less what you expect from this type of airline company. Departure with a 20 minutes delay, rather acceptable. But half way to Antalya, we are told that the plane is going to do an emergency landing in Makhachkala, due to a technical issue (I learned later that it was the main radio system on board which was dead). After a rather stressful period in the air and a rough landing in Makhachkala, we waited one hour and a half on board with no information. Finally we were told that another plane was in preparation to take us for the second half of our trip, but that we should again go through all controls including passports control, like if we were indeed coming from this destination ! On ground at Makhachkala airport, of course no assistance and no ground staff...A difficult passport control for me, because I was probably the only european passenger on board this flight. The custom agent found a detail that she did not like on my passport, went away with it and let me wait during half an hour, seeing all my fellow passengers already gone on board the new plane. Finally, probably after a phone contact with Moscow, she handed back my passport and I was free to board. Result : landing in Antalya with almost 5 hours delay, a lot of stress, no assistance, no excuse...And when I claimed for a partial refund, I received a very rude letter, listing all Russian Federation laws that does not entitle to any refund when the delay is due to a technical problem on the plane. Like this RedWings is at ease to carry on with poor maintenance of its aircraft, resulting into technical issues and delays, hoping that one day, it will not result in a more tragic consequence ! Compared to other "low cost" airlines on the same route (Corendon, Pegasus...), I strongly recommend NOT to use Red Wings.

reviews.title: Avoid at all cost, Customer Service is non existent
reviews.text: I was issued the wrong ticket by their website and at all cost they refused to correct it. I am traveling halfway round the world and I have to do this without baggage thanks to redwings. Their light fair they have issued me has no refund value and no right to buy luggage. They point blank refuse to sell me even extra luggage. I am expected to travel to airport and hope that there will be space on the plane to buy extra luggage and if not throw away my luggage. I am in this trouble only because I trusted their link emailed to me to continue with completing my booking. If you are desperate to book only book directly from website and not any link they email you. Do not even bother contacting their 24/7 help line they are robots without managers which only repeat we can not help you. Do you have any other questions??? and if you insist they cut the line. I have been contacting them 18 days in advance of my flight. P.S. It is even a waste of time writing this review as Red Wings don't value feedback as here is full of low rated review. I write for you travellers to be very vigilant buying tickets from this airline. I will update my review once I have completed my travel.

reviews.title: Worst experience

So, I have tried before the flight to change the ticket online for another date, but their web-site was not working on this option plus it was hanging when it came to the point of making change, I have tried as well to call the hot line, but no one would respond, just continuous waiting. Finally they considered me as no-show customer and I lost my ticket totally. When I wrote to them in their feedback form on the web-site - they answered me firstly that I was no show, and after on 27.07 they replied that I need to send a written letter on their address via normal post, while I never expected that in 21 century any company would do so, since long time all respectful airlines and business companies are replying by e-mail officially. I guess they just hope that written letter would not reach them - so, they can close the case without giving any feedback. The worst experience ever. Never recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: I honestly recommend you avoid this airline because you will get overcharged, disrespected and mistreated
reviews.text: Red Wings airline – Deceptive prices, made up additional charges and rudest staff ever I must warn all travelers about Red Wings airline because they are the most unprofessional and untrustworthy airline I had a misfortune of dealing with. I am a frequent traveller and I traveled through Europe, Asia and Africa and I never encountered such treatment. Me and my husband and mother flew from Belgrade, Serbia to Moscow Domodedovo airport (outbound: march 23rd and return march 30th 2019). First – they make the booking process really complicated and you don’t have the option to get a ticket with check-in baggage (I purchased tickets via skyscanner, sent them additional baggage request just to be informed that the airline does not offer that option). I contacted Red Wings and got the response I can purchase the baggage on their website, but since I didn’t purchase my ticket via their website but via third-party site, that was impossible. So they told me I could purchase additional baggage at their counter at the airport and that the price would be 2500 Russian rubles (around 35 euro). That was not true – because they charged me 50 euro for that (I kept the receipt)! Second – the airplane personal was the rudest ever – I never saw such treatment, no smiles, no please – they were fighting with some passengers in the rudest manner. Third – on our way back – they CHARGED US ADDIDIONALLY for the carry-on luggage! I flew around the world with that suitcase and low cost and regular, and NEVER, no one ever charged me the price of a 23kg suitcase for a 5KG bag that fits the global carry-on standards but only in Russia it is bigger than allowed (!!!). Just to be clear – in Belgrade (where we were flying from) they regularly checked it and let us pass without problems, this was just on the way back. Fourth – since we made a complaint at the Domodedovo airport in Moscow not just because it was outrageous to charge for a bag that was free on our way over, but because the staff at the check-in was extremely rude, unhelpful and even dismissive and sarcastic – all three of us were shocked at that behavior. That was March 30th, and to this day (April 8th) no one from the Red Wings airline made contact or responded to the complaint. So to sum up – I honestly recommend you avoid this airline because you will get overcharged, disrespected and mistreated and that is something you don’t want when you travel. They are deceptive about their prices and very rude to their customers so it is safe to say I will never travel with them again, nor will my friends and acquaintances.

reviews.title: Escaping from the Arctic Flying Adventure
reviews.text: I were not actually booked to fly with Red Wings, but ended up flying with Red Wings due to one of those code-share deals. Nonetheless - I enjoy riding in "old" aircraft - and that was exactly what I got. I was booked and checked in with Nordavia. I climbed on board the airside bus when boarding was called - the bus drove over to a Nordavia aircraft - the ground handler then "corrected" the driver and we found ourselves boarding the old Tupolev Tu-204. So, I climb on up the stairs - take my allocated seat - look around - at this point I am pleased to get a ride in the old Tupolev, but taking a mental note the interior seems a little worse for wear. Statistics are on my side - so I relax - and ignore that mechanical maintenance is likely similar to the aircraft interior. I'm looking out the window - see the Nordavia aircraft is boarding. Hang on. Am I on the right flight? Where am I going today??? So, I stand up and saunter over to the flight attendants - holding out my Nordavia boarding pass I ask the question in English; "Excuse me. Am I on the right flight?". Answer; something that I understood to be along the lines of "same place" with a shrug. I weren't even sure what language I heard. OK - so I'll chance it - I'll take this ride. I figure I have a half-reasonable chance of at least heading closer to my destination, than where I'm starting my day - and I'm always up for an adventure. Right! So I'm strapped in! ready for blast off! preflight safety brief time! Huh? Where's the English? I thought international aviation regulations stated they needed an English broadcast (but hey - I may be wrong there - maybe???). But they did know - they had at least one non-Russian speaker on board. The flight itself went well. Added bonus... we actually landed at DME as per my flight booking! I'm happy as a pig in - yeah, you know the stuff! Wander off to the luggage carousel - and it is only here - that I discovered this flight was actually a code-share arrangement. Would I fly Red Wings again? Yes - only because I'm always up for an adventure. As they say' "getting there is half the journey". Would I recommend Red Wings? If you are on a budget - enjoy a potential adventure - you're an avgeek - and not fussed about the service. Sure - Go for it!
reviews.author: David Fleming
